description:
A clinic coordinator needs to add patient Margaret Wilson to the orthopedic surgery waiting list in OSCAR EMR.

Credentials: username 'oscardoc', password 'oscar', PIN '1117'

Steps:
1. Log in to OSCAR EMR at http://localhost:8080/oscar/login.do
2. Navigate to the Waiting List module. You can find this from the main OSCAR page — look for a 'Waiting List' link in the navigation/menu area, or navigate via the Administration section.
3. Create a new waiting list named 'Orthopedic Surgery' (if no such list exists already).
4. Search for and add patient Margaret Wilson to the 'Orthopedic Surgery' waiting list.
5. In the note/comment field for the entry, enter exactly: 'Awaiting total hip replacement - left side. Moderate osteoarthritis. Target surgery date Q2 2025.'
6. Save the entry.

The patient Margaret Wilson already exists in the system. After completion, she should appear on the 'Orthopedic Surgery' waiting list with the specified note.
